summary: Fort Worth-based; the largest US airline, with its main hub at Dallas/Fort Worth.
checkin: Online and app check-in opens 24 hours before departure and closes 45 minutes before (90 for international). To check bags on US flights, be at the counter 45 minutes before departure.
baggage: Every fare, including Basic Economy, gets a carry-on and a personal item. Domestic checked bags: 1st $45 prepaid / $50 at the airport, 2nd $55 / $60. Basic Economy (tickets from May 18, 2026): 1st $50 / $55, 2nd $60 / $65.
tips: Prepay bags online or in the app to save $5 per bag.
AAdvantage status members and premium cabin passengers still get free bags.
American recommends arriving 2 hours before domestic flights.
